feature_daily_wheel_enabled.description: Kill switch: Daily Wheel. Set false to hide the wheel entirely.

feature_cloud_save_enabled.description: Kill switch: Google Sign-In cloud save. Set false if restore misbehaves in the wild.

feature_share_enabled.description: Kill switch: the win-screen share button.

interstitial_min_levels.description: Fewest levels between interstitial ads (storage.js rollInterstitialThreshold).

rewarded_ad_cap_hint.description: Max rewarded hint ads a player may watch per day.

rewarded_ad_cap_continue.description: Max rewarded continue-after-fail ads per day.

gems_per_star.description: Gems awarded per star on an ordinary level.

gems_per_star_milestone.description: Gems awarded per star on a milestone level.

star_pace_fast_multiplier.description: Clear within parTime x this and 3 stars are still possible.

star_pace_ok_multiplier.description: Clear within parTime x this and 2 stars are still possible.
